init_distributed_process_group: init a torch distributed process group with nccl backend using rank and world size from SLURM or manual args
allgather_tensor_across_ranks: gather tensors from all ranks into a single concatenated tensor using the AllGather autograd function
allreduce_sum_tensor: sum a tensor across all ranks using the AllReduceSum autograd function for distributed training
allreduce_mean_tensor: compute the mean of a tensor across all ranks using the AllReduce autograd function for distributed training
review_distributed_utils: review the distributed training utilities including init_distributed, AllGather, AllReduceSum, and AllReduce classes
